'''Vader's training chambers''' were located in [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] [[Darth Vader's Palace|castle]]. It consisted of a combat arena in which he could practice his [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber combat]] skills against modified [[ASP-19 battle droid/Legends|ASP-19 battle droids]]. In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] met with [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Spy/Legends|spy]] [[Wrenga Jixton|Jix]] and his [[Noghri/Legends|Noghri]] [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]] [[Kohvrekhar]] here.
